:::{.cr-section}

[@cr-petri]{scale-by=".5"} This section of the tutorial will demonstrate how to implement
different treatment strategies and summarise outcomes in a DES model. 

[@cr-petri]{scale-by=".5"}  The table shown here is our ultimate goal---it shows cost and QALY outcomes, 
as well as incremental cost-effectiveness results, for the four strategies considered in
alarid2023introductory. 


:::{#cr-petri}
![](images/petri-model5.png){fig-align="center"}
:::
:::{#cr-run}




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-line-numbers="true"}
# Standard of Care (no treatments)
set.seed(123)
run.SoC <- des_run(modifyList(inputs, list(treatA = FALSE, treatB = FALSE)))

#- Treatment A
set.seed(123)
run.A <- des_run(modifyList(inputs, list(treatA = TRUE, treatB = FALSE)))
run.A %>% as_tibble() %>% filter(name == "patient2") %>% mutate(foo = !as.integer(resource == "time_in_model")) %>% arrange(foo,start_time,end_time) %>% dplyr::select(-foo)
```
